youtube_title: Son's Voice Crying for Money? It Might Be AI. Scam of the Week #6 #Shorts
youtube_description:
SCAM OF THE WEEK #6. 11 PM, mom gets a call: her son's voice, crying, 'I had an accident, send 50,000 now.' But it isn't him - AI cloned his voice from a few seconds of his social media videos.
What should mom do? A: send the money fast. B: hang up and call her son back on his saved number.
Answer: B. Police and bank advisories on AI voice scams say: hang up, call the person back yourself on the number you have, and verify before paying. Set a family code word only your family knows. Scammed? Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
Source: Tamil Nadu Cyber Crime Police and bank advisories on AI voice-clone scams; Business Standard, Jan 2026.

Sahi hai B ✅ Pehle call back karke verify. Ghar mein ek family code word rakho. Fraud ho jaye toh turant 1930.
